zh.title: 阿聯酋航空2026年夏季暫停布拉格（PRG）與格拉斯哥（GLA）A380航班
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空夏季暫停PRG、GLA A380航班；10月恢復每日服務
body: 根據Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空已於2026年夏季暫時停止前往布拉格與格拉斯哥這兩個長途目的地的空中巴士A380客機航班服務。此項暫停服務暫時改變了該公司在夏季班表期間對這兩個歐陸目的地的機型部署。
阿聯酋航空規劃於2026年10月恢復布拉格與格拉斯哥的每日空中巴士A380巨無霸客機服務，屆時將恢復這兩條長途航線的常態每日營運。
在歷史機隊背景方面，阿聯酋航空工程部門先前推動了一項數十億美元的機隊改裝計畫，旨在全面翻新旗下219架空中巴士A380與波音777客機。

en.title: Emirates Temporarily Suspends A380 Flights to Prague (PRG)                                                                                                                                                                      and Glasgow (GLA)                                                                                                                                                                      for Summer 2026
en.summary: Emirates suspends Prague and Glasgow A380 flights for summer; daily services return in October
body: According to a report by Simple Flying, Emirates has temporarily suspended its Airbus A380 superjumbo flights to Prague  and Glasgow  for the summer 2026 season. The temporary suspension alters scheduled aircraft operations to both European destinations during the summer schedule.
The airline expects daily Airbus A380 services to return to both Prague and Glasgow in October 2026, resuming normal daily superjumbo operations on the two long-haul routes.

In historical fleet developments, Emirates Engineering previously launched a multi-billion-dollar retrofit program to fully refurbish 219 Airbus A380 and Boeing 777 aircraft across the carrier's widebody fleet.
